svg.title: A beat that runs long: missed grid points are skipped, never caught up
svg.text: The work for one beat runs long. The loop misses grid points, and does not catch up.
_skip_beats() advances the next-tick anchor straight past every missed point, counts the two in
SchedulerContext::overruns, and logs one aggregated warning per SCHEDULER_XRUN_LOG_MS. Catching up with a
burst of back-to-back ticks would only deepen the overrun that caused it.
